annotation.title_clean: Cabinet paper DEV-21-SUB-0033: Release of Discussion Document – Enabling Drone Integration
annotation.title_en: Cabinet paper DEV-21-SUB-0033: Release of Discussion Document – Enabling Drone Integration
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Office of the Minister of Transport (New Zealand Ministry of Transport)
annotation.venue: New Zealand Ministry of Transport website
named_instruments_referenced: Taking Flight: an aviation system for the automated age
annotation.summary_en: New Zealand Cabinet paper seeking approval to publicly consult on "Enabling Drone Integration". It proposes updated Civil Aviation Rules, a mandatory basic pilot test, registration of drones over 250g, remote identification and geo-awareness, to improve safety, security and privacy while enabling innovation and long-term integration of drones into the aviation system.
key_provisions_or_claims: Update Civil Aviation Rules Part 101, e.g. relaxing consent for flying over people and property
Mandatory online basic pilot theory test for Part 101 operators
Mandatory registration of drones above 250 grams and their owners
Remote identification and geo-awareness, to be mandated once technical standards are adopted
Six-week public consultation; phased implementation with RIA after consultation
